user.title: Grocery Assistant - HA
user.description: Adds the shared shopping list for the Grocery Assistant app. Then open Configure to assign Adult and Junior roles.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Adult: adds, insists, shops, sees costs and hidden buttons. Junior: adds and insists, does not see "Adults only" items. None: cannot use the app.

juniors.title: Junior costs
juniors.description: Each Junior's "Just for me" items are charged to the Adult chosen here.

push.title: Push notifications
push.description: Paste the JSON key of the Firebase project's service account. Leave empty to turn push off.

firefly.title: Firefly III
firefly.description: Firefly III address, personal access token and the ID of the source account. Leave empty to unlink.

error.invalid_service_account: Not a valid service account key (project_id, client_email and private_key are required).
error.firefly_cannot_connect: Firefly III does not answer with this address and token.
